Stress-test the current fantasy visual semantics by rendering the agent-selected wyvern plus hydra pair in a complex photorealistic scene, using the attached portrait only as visible appearance guidance for an original adult fictional woman.

Create a photorealistic fantasy field-biologist photograph of an original adult fictional woman whose visible facial appearance and long dark wavy hair are guided by Image 1. At a volcanic plateau observatory above steaming fumaroles, she stands beside a calibrated range pole and records two separate creatures in one wide frame. A complete wyvern lands on a basalt ledge with one continuous body: exactly two membrane wings attach at the shoulders and occupy the forelimb positions, exactly two weight-bearing hind legs descend from the pelvis, and one uncropped tail balances the landing. Farther downslope, one grounded hydra has a single shared torso and belly supporting at least three clearly separate neck roots; each long neck remains distinct to a visible head. Keep the two creatures spatially separated and at readable scale, with her tablet, range pole, contact shadows, and displaced ash anchoring the survey action. Preserve the reference-visible facial structure, hairline, dark wavy hair texture, and natural makeup balance. Use a crisp wide documentary composition that keeps her face readable while showing the full topology of both creatures.
